scope: Read-only audit of canonical vehicle sources and final Unity screenshots; public reference and model acquisition research. No FBX, scene, code, account or purchase changes.
targetSite: 台北公館：汀州路三段 × 羅斯福路四段90巷
conclusion: 現有車輛是原創通用造型，沒有對應到現地某一台、某年份、某版本的實車。增加面數、螺絲或換色無法補足主輪廓和面板曲率。必須先辨識並鎖定實車，再採集或取得該車型的完整參考與模型。

sedan.identity: Original contemporary compact sedan; not a verified Toyota, Mitsubishi or other production vehicle
sedan.sourceEvidence: refine_car.py lines 76–123 define the body from width, belt and crown scalar profiles; lines 164–172 use planar door-glazing quads; trim and lamp features are separate tubes, boxes and panels.
sedan.observation: 最終截圖的車身接近厚重平板：前鼻、葉子板、車門和輪拱缺少真車不同區域的曲率過渡，窗框接近等厚細桿，側窗四邊形過直。燈條/格柵像附著在外殼上；主面缺少實際引擎蓋分界、燈罩深度、保險桿凹槽和壓折關係。
sedan.interpretation: These are shape-design limitations, not a remaining triangle-count or backface-culling defect. Existing geometry checks validate integrity, not resemblance to a real car.

scooter.identity: Scooter125_Hero and derived Fleet are an original generic 125 cc scooter, not a verified GP125, Duke, Cygnus or other production model
scooter.sourceEvidence: Rear monocoque, saddle and leg shield are authored from a small number of loft/shield cross sections; fleet-report names the same Hero blend as source.
scooter.observation: Final parked row repeats the same rounded rear body, rounded shield, twin round headlamp arrangement and round mirrors with paint changes. Side body looks inflated and seat outline is very thin; it reads as a stylized retro family, not a survey of distinct commuter scooters.
scooter.interpretation: 先校對前斜板/車頭燈殼/座墊/後側蓋/腳踏板的輪廓與位置，再處理螺絲、縫線和磨耗。不要把多種顏色當成多個真實車款。

materialsAndLighting.observation: Sedan uses ten largely uniform materials. The screenshots show broad uniform paint, strongly reflective opaque windows, very clean rims and repeated scooter paint response. Street reflections lack the local shopfront detail present in the real Outlander photo.
materialsAndLighting.priority: After silhouette approval: distinguish clearcoat paint, rough black moulded plastic, rubber, metal, layered lamp lenses and interior darkness; then localized wear and environment reflections. Avoid adding uniform noise to hide shape errors.

priorityOrder.action: Fix target capture date and establish a vehicle inventory from the actual junction
priorityOrder.deliverable: For each foreground vehicle: photo IDs, camera direction/location, suspected make/model/generation/trim, confidence, dimensions source, and whether it is a literal site match or representative filler. Unknown must remain unknown.

priorityOrder.action: Select one accessible physical scooter and one identified nearby car for complete reference capture
priorityOrder.deliverable: Front/rear/left/right, front/rear three-quarter, elevated views and matched detail photos; measure wheelbase, wheel diameter, width, seat height and camera height. Use one vehicle through the full set and consistent exposure. Photograph close-up panel gaps, lights, mirrors, tyre sidewalls and cockpit separately.

priorityOrder.action: Acquire the same-generation authored asset or reconstruct from the complete reference set
priorityOrder.deliverable: Prefer a verified original-author game-licensed source if it exactly matches. For poorly covered Taiwan commuter scooters, custom modeling from measured multi-view photography is more reliable than renaming an unrelated scooter asset. Glossy paint/glass cannot be assumed to scan cleanly; a scan is supporting shape evidence, followed by cleanup and authored surfaces.

priorityOrder.action: Approve proportions and primary surfaces before detail work
priorityOrder.deliverable: Calibrated front/side/rear silhouette overlays; wheel centers and overall dimensions; hood/fender/bumper and scooter shield/seat/side-cover curvature under a neutral reflective test material. Existing gameplay collider dimensions are not the measurement authority for a real vehicle.

priorityOrder.action: Finish materials and secondary shapes, then optimize and integrate
priorityOrder.deliverable: Realistic panel gaps, inset lamps, glass/interior relationship, PBR textures and localized wear; only then LODs, pivots, collision proxy fit and matched-camera Unity validation. Reuse several actually distinct source models for the parked fleet rather than color-only variants.

captureAndAcceptanceLimits: A single photograph cannot establish a complete vehicle shape, invisible surfaces, true scale or exact camera calibration.
Official 360 product images and real dimensions constrain silhouette but do not themselves supply production CAD, material maps or unseen underbody details.
More triangles, passing collider/anchor tests and corrected normals establish technical function, not photographic similarity.
No free, licensed, high-quality exact GP125/Duke replacement was verified in this bounded search. This is a search result, not a claim none exists.
No authenticated multi-view vehicle capture set for the exact target junction was found among current local references.
All external model leads remain uninspected candidates. No paid action, account creation, model download or Unity modification occurred.
